FACULTY OF ENGINEERING
Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering
English Language Requirements for ECE Graduate Admissions
If English
is not your native language, to be eligible to apply to Graduate School you
must complete an English proficiency test.
The minimum scores required for
graduate programs in ECE are:
TOEFL: minimum score of 92 (internet based), 237 (computer based) or 580 (paper
based), minimum of 20 per band
IELTS (Academic): minimum overall score of 6.5, with at least 5.5 in each section
CAEL: minimum overall score of 70, with at least 60 per band
MELAB: minimum score of 85
PTE Academic: minimum score of 63; for the Faculty of Engineering a minimum score
of 70
York University course: YUELI Level 6 with a minimum final grade of B
University of Toronto course: Academic Level 60 with a minimum final grade of B
